Nothing in this contract\n///      branches on a secret.\ncontract HearthVault is\n    IHearthVault,\n    IERC7984Receiver,\n    ZamaEthereumConfig,\n    Ownable2Step,\n    Pausable,\n    ReentrancyGuard\n{\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @dev `cum` is balance-seconds accumulated since the start of the period containing `ts`.\n    struct Observation {\n        euint64 cum;\n        euint64 balance;\n        uint32 ts;\n    }\n\n    struct TotalObservation {\n        euint128 cum;\n        euint64 balance;\n        uint32 ts;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev What a saver was evaluated on and what they won in one draw, both readable by that saver only.\n    struct Outcome {\n        euint64 weight;\n        euint64 credit;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev How the aggregate weight of a period compared against the pool's tracked scale bracket.\n    struct Scale {\n        euint8 count;\n        ebool nonEmpty;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev A tier's unpaid liquidity, riding along encrypted until the tier's reconcile cadence is due.\n    ///      `publishedHandle` is pinned at publication so a later fold cannot change what the pool books.\n    struct Carry {\n        euint64 balance;\n        euint64 publishedHandle;\n        uint32 publishedAt;\n        bool pending;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Everything one draw needs on this side: where its evaluation walk starts, how far it has got,\n    ///      and what each tier still has to give.\n    struct DrawState {\n        uint32 start;\n        uint32 length;\n        uint32 cursor;\n        uint32 evaluated;\n        bool opened;\n        bool finalized;\n        euint64[3] remaining;\n    }\n\n    uint8 public constant TIERS = 3;\n\n    /// @notice Observations kept per saver and for the total. Three slots cover the newest observation at or\n    ///         before any draw inside its two-period window, because at most two later periods can have\n    ///         started and so at most two newer observations can have been pushed.\n    uint8 public constant SLOTS = 3;\n\n    /// @notice How many powers of two the aggregate weight is compared against at each close.\n    uint8 public constant SCALE_PROBES = 5;\n\n    /// @notice Savers needing encrypted work per `evaluate` call.\n    /// @dev Measured with `fhevm.computeTransactionHCU` against the mock coprocessor's price table,\n    ///      not on Sepolia, using the Sepolia tier parameters (prize counts 1, 1 and 4\n    ///      at odds 1/24, 1/6 and 1): 748,032 homomorphic compute units of fixed cost per call plus\n    ///      3,674,128 per saver. Emits Deposited whether or not the amount was zero; the event\n    ///      carries no amount by design.\n    function onConfidentialTransferReceived(\n        address,\n        address from,\n        euint64 amount,\n        bytes calldata\n    ) external override whenNotPaused returns (ebool) {\n        if (msg.sender != address(asset)) revert NotTheAsset();\n\n        _register(from);\n\n        euint64 grown = FHE.add(_principal[from], amount);\n        ebool accepted = FHE.and(FHE.le(amount, maxPrincipal), FHE.le(grown, maxPrincipal));\n        euint64 principal = FHE.select(accepted, grown, _principal[from]);\n        euint64 credited = FHE.select(accepted, amount, FHE.asEuint64(0));\n\n        _principal[from] = principal;\n        _grant(principal, from);\n        _observe(from, principal);\n        _observeTotal(FHE.add(_total[0].balance, credited));\n\n        emit Deposited(from);\n\n        FHE.allowThis(accepted);\n        FHE.allowTransient(accepted, msg.sender);\n        return accepted;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraws up to `encryptedAmount`, winnings first, then principal, clamped to the saver's\n    ///         total and to what the vault itself holds.\n    /// @dev An oversized request returns everything instead of reverting, so a balance cannot be probed.\n    ///      Reverts NotASaver for an address that never deposited. Emits Withdrawn.\n    function withdrawAll() external nonReentrant {\n        if (!isSaver[msg.sender]) revert NotASaver();\n        _withdraw(FHE.add(_principal[msg.sender], _winnings[msg.sender]));\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthVault\n    /// @dev Reverts NotThePrizePool for any other caller, PeriodNotOver while `period` is still running,\n    ///      and HistoryLost if the total observations no longer reach back to `period`, which cannot\n    ///      happen inside the two-period window.\n    function scaleFor(uint32 period, uint8 bits) external returns (euint8 count, ebool nonEmpty) {\n        if (msg.sender != address(prizePool)) revert NotThePrizePool();\n        if (_currentPeriod() <= period) revert PeriodNotOver(period);\n\n        euint128 weight = _totalWeight(period);\n        nonEmpty = FHE.gt(weight, uint128(0));\n\n        euint8[SCALE_PROBES] memory cleared;\n        for (uint256 probe = 0; Reverts\n    ///      NotThePrizePool for any other caller and DrawAlreadyOpen on a repeat.\n    function openDraw(uint32 drawId, uint64[3] calldata offered) external {\n        if (msg.sender != address(prizePool)) revert NotThePrizePool();\n        DrawState storage state = _draws[drawId];\n        if (state.opened) revert DrawAlreadyOpen(drawId);\n\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            euint64 available = FHE.asEuint64(offered[tier]);\n            if (!_carry[tier].pending) {\n                available = FHE.add(available, _carry[tier].balance);\n                _carry[tier].balance = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n                FHE.allowThis(_carry[tier].balance);\n            }\n            state.remaining[tier] = available;\n            FHE.allowThis(available);\n        }\n        state.opened = true;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthVault\n    /// @dev Nothing was paid, so what the draw holds is exactly `offered` plus whatever carry was folded\n    ///      in at the open. Reverts NotThePrizePool for any other caller and CarryNotPending when\n    ///      that tier has nothing awaiting reconciliation, which is the replay guard.\n    function consumeCarry(uint8 tier, uint64 amount) external {\n        if (msg.sender != address(prizePool)) revert NotThePrizePool();\n        if (tier >= TIERS) revert InvalidTier(tier);\n        if (!_carry[tier].pending) revert CarryNotPending(tier);\n\n        _carry[tier].balance = FHE.sub(_carry[tier].balance, amount);\n        _carry[tier].pending = false;\n        FHE.allowThis(_carry[tier].balance);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Advances the evaluation walk of `drawId` by up to `count` savers, crediting each one what\n    ///         the published thresholds say they won.\n    /// @dev Anyone may call, any number of times, inside the draw's window of periods `drawId + 1` and\n    ///      `drawId + 2`. Pulls the encrypted\n    ///      total credited from the pool. Emits Evaluated per saver.\n    function evaluate(uint32 drawId, uint256 count) external nonReentrant {\n        if (address(prizePool) == address(0)) revert PrizePoolNotSet();\n        uint32 period = _currentPeriod();\n        if (period < drawId + 1 || period > drawId + 2) revert EvaluationWindowClosed(drawId);\n\n        IHearthPrizePool.DrawParams memory draw = prizePool.drawParams(drawId);\n        if (draw.status != IHearthPrizePool.DrawStatus.Awarded) revert DrawNotAwarded(drawId);\n\n        DrawState storage state = _draws[drawId];\n        if (state.length == 0) {\n            uint256 total = _savers.length;\n            if (total == 0) return;\n            state.length = uint32(total);\n            state.start = uint32(draw.seed % total);\n        }\n        _walk(draw, drawId, state, count);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Folds every tier's unpaid remainder into that tier's carry once the window of `drawId` is\n    ///         over, and publishes the carry of each tier whose reconcile cadence is due.\n    /// @dev Anyone may call, once per draw, after period `drawId + 2`. decryptable by that saver\n    ///         only, so they can check it against the published thresholds themselves.\n    function weightHandle(uint32 drawId, address saver) external view returns (euint64) {\n        return _outcomes[drawId][saver].weight;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice What `saver` won in `drawId`; decryptable by that saver only.\n    function creditHandle(uint32 drawId, address saver) external view returns (euint64) {\n        return _outcomes[drawId][saver].credit;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice One of the saver's three observations: slot 0 is the newest, slot 2 the oldest kept.\n    function observationOf(address saver, uint8 slot) external view returns (euint64 cum, euint64 balance, uint32 ts) {\n        Observation storage obs = _observations[saver][slot];\n        return (obs.cum, obs.balance, obs.ts);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Winnings credited that the prize pool failed to back. Zero whenever the pool is solvent.\n    function unfundedHandle() external view returns (euint64) {\n        return _unfunded;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice How many savers have been marked done for `drawId`, so the app can show progress.\n    function evaluatedCount(uint32 drawId) external view returns (uint32) {\n        return _draws[drawId].evaluated;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice How far the evaluation walk of `drawId` has advanced.\n    function cursorOf(uint32 drawId) external view returns (uint32) {\n        return _draws[drawId].cursor;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Where the evaluation walk of `drawId` starts and how many savers it covers.\n    /// @dev Both are zero until the first `evaluate` call fixes them from the seed and the saver count.\n    /// @return start Index in the saver list the walk begins at.\n    /// @return count How many savers the walk covers. Named `count` rather than `length`, which\n    ///         collides with a tuple's own `length` in generated TypeScript clients and makes the\n    ///         return type unusable there.\n    function walkOf(uint32 drawId) external view returns (uint32 start, uint32 count) {\n        DrawState storage state = _draws[drawId];\n        return (state.start, state.length);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IHearthVault\n    function finalized(uint32 drawId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return _draws[drawId].finalized;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice True once the prize pool has moved a draw's liquidity into this vault.\n    function opened(uint32 drawId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return _draws[drawId].opened;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice How many addresses have ever deposited. The list is never pruned.\n    function saverCount() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _savers.length;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The saver at `index` in the list evaluation walks.\n    function saverAt(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {\n        return _savers[index];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The period the chain is in right now.\n    function currentPeriod() external view returns (uint32) {\n        return _currentPeriod();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The period `timestamp` falls in. Anything before `firstPeriodAt` is period zero.\n    function periodOf(uint256 timestamp) external view returns (uint32) {\n        return Periods.periodOf(timestamp, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The first second of the period after `period`.\n    function periodEnd(uint32 period) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return Periods.endOf(period, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Last moment at which `drawId` can still be evaluated; finalization opens after it.\n    function windowEndsAt(uint32 drawId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return Periods.endOf(drawId + 2, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Disabled: the vault must always have an owner able to pause deposits in an incident.\n    function renounceOwnership() public view override onlyOwner {\n        revert RenounceDisabled();\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Runs one batch of the draw's walk. Split out of `evaluate` so the window and status checks\n    ///      stay readable next to the loop that does the encrypted work.\n    function _walk(\n        IHearthPrizePool.DrawParams memory draw,\n        uint32 drawId,\n        DrawState storage state,\n        uint256 count\n    ) private {\n        uint256 length = state.length;\n        uint256 index = state.cursor;\n        uint256 processed;\n        uint256 heavy;\n        uint32 marked;\n        euint64 batchTotal;\n\n        while (index < length && processed < count && heavy < MAX_BATCH) {\n            address saver = _savers[(uint256(state.start) + index) % length];\n            index++;\n            processed++;\n            if (evaluated[drawId][saver]) continue;\n\n            evaluated[drawId][saver] = true;\n            marked++;\n            emit Evaluated(saver, drawId);\n            if (Periods.periodOf(firstObservationAt[saver], firstPeriodAt, periodLength) > drawId) continue;\n\n            heavy++;\n            euint64 twab = _weightOf(saver, drawId);\n            euint64 credit = _winnerTest(draw, state.remaining, drawId, saver, twab);\n\n            _winnings[saver] = FHE.add(_winnings[saver], credit);\n            _grant(_winnings[saver], saver);\n            _outcomes[drawId][saver] = Outcome(twab, credit);\n            _grant(twab, saver);\n            _grant(credit, saver);\n            batchTotal = heavy == 1 ? credit : FHE.add(batchTotal, credit);\n        }\n\n        state.cursor = uint32(index);\n        state.evaluated += marked;\n        if (heavy == 0) return;\n\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            FHE.allowThis(state.remaining[tier]);\n        }\n\n        FHE.allowThis(batchTotal);\n        FHE.allowTransient(batchTotal, address(prizePool));\n        euint64 sent = prizePool.fund(batchTotal);\n\n        _unfunded = FHE.add(_unfunded, FHE.sub(batchTotal, sent));\n        FHE.allowThis(_unfunded);\n    }\n\n    function _withdraw(euint64 requested) private {\n        address saver = msg.sender;\n        euint64 winnings = _winnings[saver];\n        euint64 principal = _principal[saver];\n\n        // An ERC-7984 transfer moves the whole amount or nothing, so the vault has to clamp to its own\n        // confidential balance itself. Without this a saver whose winnings the pool failed to back would\n        // ask for more than the vault holds and get nothing at all.\n        euint64 available = FHE.add(principal, winnings);\n        euint64 amount = FHE.min(FHE.min(requested, available), asset.confidentialBalanceOf(address(this)));\n        euint64 fromWinnings = FHE.min(amount, winnings);\n        euint64 fromPrincipal = FHE.sub(amount, fromWinnings);\n\n        principal = FHE.sub(principal, fromPrincipal);\n        _principal[saver] = principal;\n        _grant(principal, saver);\n        _winnings[saver] = FHE.sub(winnings, fromWinnings);\n        _grant(_winnings[saver], saver);\n        _observe(saver, principal);\n        _observeTotal(FHE.sub(_total[0].balance, fromPrincipal));\n\n        FHE.allowTransient(amount, address(asset));\n        asset.confidentialTransfer(saver, amount);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(saver);\n    }\n\n    function _register(address saver) private {\n        if (isSaver[saver]) return;\n        isSaver[saver] = true;\n        firstObservationAt[saver] = uint32(block.timestamp);\n        _savers.push(saver);\n        _principal[saver] = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        _winnings[saver] = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        _grant(_principal[saver], saver);\n        _grant(_winnings[saver], saver);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Records `newBalance` for `saver` at the current time. A change in a later period pushes the\n    ///      older observations down a slot, so the two periods of a draw's window can still be weighed.\n    function _observe(address saver, euint64 newBalance) private {\n        Observation storage current = _observations[saver][0];\n        uint32 now32 = uint32(block.timestamp);\n        uint32 period = _currentPeriod();\n\n        if (current.ts == 0) {\n            current.cum = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        } else if (Periods.periodOf(current.ts, firstPeriodAt, periodLength) == period) {\n            current.cum = FHE.add(current.cum, FHE.mul(current.balance, uint64(now32 - current.ts)));\n        } else {\n            _observations[saver][2] = _observations[saver][1];\n            _observations[saver][1] = current;\n            uint256 start = Periods.startOf(period, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            current.cum = FHE.mul(current.balance, uint64(block.timestamp - start));\n        }\n\n        current.balance = newBalance;\n        current.ts = now32;\n        FHE.allowThis(current.cum);\n        FHE.allow(current.cum, saver);\n    }\n\n    function _observeTotal(euint64 newBalance) private {\n        TotalObservation storage current = _total[0];\n        uint32 now32 = uint32(block.timestamp);\n        uint32 period = _currentPeriod();\n\n        if (current.ts == 0) {\n            current.cum = FHE.asEuint128(0);\n        } else if (Periods.periodOf(current.ts, firstPeriodAt, periodLength) == period) {\n            current.cum = FHE.add(current.cum, FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(current.balance), uint128(now32 - current.ts)));\n        } else {\n            _total[2] = _total[1];\n            _total[1] = current;\n            uint256 start = Periods.startOf(period, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            current.cum = FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(current.balance), uint128(block.timestamp - start));\n        }\n\n        current.balance = newBalance;\n        current.ts = now32;\n        FHE.allowThis(current.cum);\n        FHE.allowThis(current.balance);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Runs the nested-threshold winner test of `draw` for one saver and returns the encrypted credit.\n    ///      A tier gives `prizeCount` shots at rising public thresholds, so the number of prizes won is the\n    ///      floor or the ceiling of `twab * odds * prizeCount / M`, capped at `prizeCount`, which is linear\n    ///      in the saver's share and gains nothing from splitting a balance across wallets. What the tier\n    ///      still has to give is the only cap, applied in walk order.\n    function _winnerTest(\n        IHearthPrizePool.DrawParams memory draw,\n        euint64[3] storage remaining,\n        uint32 drawId,\n        address saver,\n        euint64 twab\n    ) private returns (euint64 credit) {\n        euint64 zero = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n\n        for (uint8 tier = 0; tier < TIERS; tier++) {\n            euint64 prize = FHE.asEuint64(draw.prize[tier]);\n            euint64 tierPay = zero;\n\n            for (uint32 index = 0; index < draw.prizeCount[tier]; index++) {\n                (uint256 threshold, bool skipped) = _thresholdOf(draw, drawId, saver, tier, index);\n                // Thresholds rise with the prize index, so once one is out of range no weight passes it.\n                if (skipped) break;\n                euint64 shot = FHE.select(FHE.gt(twab, uint64(threshold)), prize, zero);\n                tierPay = index == 0 ? shot : FHE.add(tierPay, shot);\n            }\n\n            euint64 pay = FHE.min(remaining[tier], tierPay);\n            remaining[tier] = FHE.sub(remaining[tier], pay);\n            credit = tier == 0 ? pay : FHE.add(credit, pay);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Time-weighted balance of `saver` over `period`, read from the newest observation at or before\n    ///      it. A saver whose kept history starts after `period` held nothing back then, so the answer is\n    ///      a plaintext zero at no encrypted cost. It never reverts, because one saver with a gap in their\n    ///      history must not be able to stall the walk for everybody else.\n    function _weightOf(address saver, uint32 period) private returns (euint64) {\n        Observation[3] storage slots = _observations[saver];\n        for (uint8 slot = 0; slot < SLOTS; slot++) {\n            Observation storage obs = slots[slot];\n            if (obs.ts == 0) return FHE.asEuint64(0);\n            uint32 obsPeriod = Periods.periodOf(obs.ts, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            if (obsPeriod <= period) return _weightFrom(obs, obsPeriod, period);\n        }\n        return FHE.asEuint64(0);\n    }\n\n    function _weightFrom(Observation storage obs, uint32 obsPeriod, uint32 period) private returns (euint64) {\n        if (obsPeriod == period) {\n            uint256 end = Periods.endOf(period, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            return FHE.add(obs.cum, FHE.mul(obs.balance, uint64(end - obs.ts)));\n        }\n        return FHE.mul(obs.balance, uint64(periodLength));\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The total's three slots shift at most once per period and the scale is read inside the\n    ///      two-period window, so the revert is a canary rather than a reachable path.\n    function _totalWeight(uint32 period) private returns (euint128) {\n        for (uint8 slot = 0; slot < SLOTS; slot++) {\n            TotalObservation storage obs = _total[slot];\n            if (obs.ts == 0) return FHE.asEuint128(0);\n            uint32 obsPeriod = Periods.periodOf(obs.ts, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            if (obsPeriod <= period) return _totalWeightFrom(obs, obsPeriod, period);\n        }\n        revert HistoryLost(address(this), period);\n    }\n\n    function _totalWeightFrom(\n        TotalObservation storage obs,\n        uint32 obsPeriod,\n        uint32 period\n    ) private returns (euint128) {\n        if (obsPeriod == period) {\n            uint256 end = Periods.endOf(period, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n            return FHE.add(obs.cum, FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(obs.balance), uint128(end - obs.ts)));\n        }\n        return FHE.mul(FHE.asEuint128(obs.balance), uint128(periodLength));\n    }\n\n    function _grant(euint64 handle, address saver) private {\n        FHE.allowThis(handle);\n        FHE.allow(handle, saver);\n    }\n\n    function _currentPeriod() private view returns (uint32) {\n        return Periods.periodOf(block.timestamp, firstPeriodAt, periodLength);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The public half of the winner test, shared by `evaluate` and `thresholdOf` so the app, the\n    ///      tests and a judge check outcomes against the same implementation that decided them. `M` is a\n    ///      power of two, so masking the hash gives a uniform draw in `[0, M)` with no modulo bias.\n    function _thresholdOf(\n        IHearthPrizePool.DrawParams memory draw,\n        uint32 drawId,\n        address saver,\n        uint8 tier,\n        uint32 index\n    ) private pure returns (uint256 threshold, bool skipped) {\n        uint256 range = uint256(1) << draw.scaleBits;\n        uint256 point = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(draw.seed, drawId, saver, tier))) & (range - 1);\n        threshold = ((point + uint256(index) * range) * draw.zoneDiv[tier]) / draw.zoneMul[tier];\n        skipped = threshold >= type(uint64).max;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xf3a75216e917acc9e0db3c648efc15c1eb504b5cbc01147bd1215f6e803d21ab","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IHearthPrizePool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @title IHearthPrizePool\n/// @notice What the vault needs from the prize pool: the fixed parameters of an awarded draw, the\n///         reconcile cadence of each tier, and the encrypted transfer that backs credited winnings.\ninterface IHearthPrizePool {\n    /// @dev Order is fixed once deployed: the vault and the app compare against these values by index.\n    ///      Empty is a period in which nobody held a balance, Skipped is an award that landed after the\n    ///      draw's window. Both book the harvest, hand the offered liquidity back and pay nothing.\n    enum DrawStatus {\n        None,\n        Closed,\n        Awarded,\n        Empty,\n        Skipped\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Everything the winner test needs, all public once the draw is awarded. In tier `t` a saver takes\n    ///      `prizeCount[t]` nested shots against the range `M = 1 << scaleBits`: shot `k` is won when\n    ///      `twab * zoneMul[t] > (r + k * M) * zoneDiv[t]`, for the saver's uniform draw `r` in `[0, M)`.\n    ///      Fields are declared widest first so the struct packs without a wasted slot.\n    struct DrawParams {\n        DrawStatus status;\n        uint64[3] prize;\n        uint64[3] offered;\n        uint64[3] zoneMul;\n        uint64[3] zoneDiv;\n        uint32[3] prizeCount;\n        uint64 seed;\n        uint8 scaleBits;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Transfers `amount` of the confidential asset to the vault and returns what was sent.\n    /// @dev Vault only. The vault must have allowed the pool on `amount` in the same transaction.\n    function fund(euint64 amount) external returns (euint64 sent);\n\n    /// @notice The public parameters of `drawId`, meaningful once the draw is awarded.\n    function drawParams(uint32 drawId) external view returns (DrawParams memory);\n\n    /// @notice How many draws pass between two publications of `tier`'s encrypted carry.\n    /// @dev Never zero, so the vault can use it as a modulus.\n    function reconcileEvery(uint8 tier) external view returns (uint16);\n}\n","keccak256":"0xd6434fbaa6b9f8dcd74181b52197d575ffa4fc163866401d54fb6eba99705e3b","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IHearthVault.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.27;\n\nimport {ebool, euint8, euint64} from \"@fhevm/solidity/lib/FHE.sol\";\n\n/// @title IHearthVault\n/// @notice What the prize pool needs from the vault: the period schedule, the encrypted scale of a\n///         finished period's aggregate weight, the draw's encrypted liquidity, and the per-tier carry.\ninterface IHearthVault {\n    /// @notice Compares the aggregate weight of `period` against `2^(scaleBits-2) .. 2^(scaleBits+2)` and\n    ///         against one, marks both results publicly decryptable and returns them.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only; the period must have ended. The exact aggregate is never published, because\n    ///      two consecutive aggregates and a public transaction timestamp would recover a lone mover's\n    ///      deposit exactly.\n    /// @return count How many of the five thresholds the aggregate cleared, so the pool can move its scale.\n    /// @return nonEmpty Whether anyone held a balance during `period`.\n    function scaleFor(uint32 period, uint8 scaleBits) external returns (euint8 count, ebool nonEmpty);\n\n    /// @notice Moves `offered` plus the tier's encrypted carry into the draw's encrypted liquidity.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, once per draw.\n    function openDraw(uint32 drawId, uint64[3] calldata offered) external;\n\n    /// @notice Gives a draw that will never pay back: the plaintext `offered` returns to the pool and the\n    ///         encrypted part returns to the tier's carry.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, for a draw that was opened and is not finalized.\n    function abandonDraw(uint32 drawId, uint64[3] calldata offered) external;\n\n    /// @notice Subtracts a reconciled `amount` from `tier`'s encrypted carry and clears the publication.\n    /// @dev Prize pool only, and only while that tier has a published carry awaiting reconciliation.\n    function consumeCarry(uint8 tier, uint64 amount) external;\n\n    function periodLength() external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function firstPeriodAt() external view returns (uint256);\n\n    /// @notice True once `finalizeDraw` folded `drawId` into the carries, or the draw was abandoned.\n    function finalized(uint32 drawId) external view returns (bool);\n\n    /// @notice The encrypted liquidity of each tier that `drawId` has not paid out.\n    function remainingHandles(uint32 drawId) external view returns (euint64[3] memory);\n\n    /// @notice The carry handle `tier` published, the draw it was published at, and whether it is still\n    ///         waiting to be reconciled.\n    function publishedCarry(uint8 tier) external view returns (euint64 handle, uint32 publishedAt, bool pending);\n}\n","keccak256":"0xe62a68e214e868a1efce04bcbf809e0f77b7c2e4f8a9c88f3c57251bb175d390","license":"MIT"},"contracts/libraries/Periods.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma length) internal pure returns (uint32) {\n        if (timestamp < first) return 0;\n        return uint32((timestamp - first) / length + 1);\n    }\n\n    function startOf(uint32 period, uint256 first, uint256 length) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return first + (uint256(period) - 1) * length;\n    }\n\n    function endOf(uint32 period, uint256 first, uint256 length) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return first + uint256(period) * length;\n devdoc.details: Deposits arrive through the ERC-7984 receive hook. The only exits are `withdraw` and      `withdrawAll`, which pay winnings first and principal second in one confidential transfer, so a      winner's exit is indistinguishable from anyone else's. The draw schedule lives here      (`periodLength`, `firstPeriodAt`); the prize pool reads it. Evaluation walks the saver list from a      seed-derived start, so nobody chooses who is evaluated or in what order. Nothing in this contract      branches on a secret.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

abandonDraw(uint32,uint64[3]).details: Nothing was paid, so what the draw holds is exactly `offered` plus whatever carry was folded      in at the open. The plaintext half goes back to the pool's liquidity and the encrypted half      back to the carry. Reverts NotThePrizePool for any other caller, DrawNotOpen for a draw that      was never opened and AlreadyFinalized on a repeat.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.asset_: The confidential ERC-7984 token savers deposit.
params.owner_: Account allowed to pause deposits and wire the prize pool.
params.periodLength_: Draw period in seconds, at least one minute.

consumeCarry(uint8,uint64).details: The carry may have grown since publication, so the verified amount is subtracted rather than      the balance zeroed. Reverts NotThePrizePool for any other caller and CarryNotPending when      that tier has nothing awaiting reconciliation, which is the replay guard.

evaluate(uint32,uint256).details: Anyone may call, any number of times, inside the draw's window of periods `drawId + 1` and      `drawId + 2`. The walk starts at `seed mod saverCount` and runs the list in order, so the      caller chooses how many savers to advance but never which ones, and a saver who advances the      walk to reach themselves is doing what the keeper does. Savers with no observation at or      before the draw's period are marked done in plaintext at no encrypted cost. At most      `MAX_BATCH` savers per call need encrypted work; the call stops there and the next call      resumes from the cursor. Reverts PrizePoolNotSet, EvaluationWindowClosed outside the window,      and DrawNotAwarded for a draw that is None, Closed, Empty or Skipped. Pulls the encrypted      total credited from the pool. Emits Evaluated per saver.

finalizeDraw(uint32).details: Anyone may call, once per draw, after period `drawId + 2`. Reverts AlreadyFinalized on a      repeat or for a draw that was abandoned, EvaluationWindowOpen before the window ends,      DrawNotOpen for a draw that was never closed, and DrawNotAwarded for a draw whose award has      not landed yet. That last one matters: awarding is what books the draw's harvest, and a draw      folded into the carries first could never be awarded afterwards, because the award's own      hand-back would find the draw already finalized. Emits CarryPublished for each due tier and      DrawFinalized.

onConfidentialTransferReceived(address,a.details: `amount` is what the token actually moved, already clamped to the sender's balance. A deposit      that would push the saver above `maxPrincipal`, or that is itself above it, is refused by      returning an encrypted false, which makes the token refund it in the same transaction. Both      halves of that test are needed: the sum alone can wrap 64 bits for an amount near the token's      maximum and then read as acceptable. Reverts NotTheAsset for any other caller and      EnforcedPause while paused. Emits Deposited whether or not the amount was zero; the event      carries no amount by design.

openDraw(uint32,uint64[3]).details: A tier whose carry is awaiting reconciliation keeps it: folding a published amount into a draw      would let the pool book liquidity that has already been offered again. Reverts      NotThePrizePool for any other caller and DrawAlreadyOpen on a repeat.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

scaleFor(uint32,uint8).details: Reverts NotThePrizePool for any other caller, PeriodNotOver while `period` is still running,      and HistoryLost if the total observations no longer reach back to `period`, which cannot      happen inside the two-period window.

returns.count: How many of the five thresholds the aggregate cleared, so the pool can move its scale.
returns.nonEmpty: Whether anyone held a balance during `period`.

setPrizePool(address).details: Reverts PrizePoolAlreadySet on a second call and ZeroAddress for the zero address. Emits      PrizePoolSet.

thresholdOf(uint32,address,uint8,uint32).details: The same arithmetic evaluation runs, so a judge or the app's verify page can recompute any      outcome from public data and the saver's own decrypted weight: the saver won this prize      exactly when their weight is strictly above `threshold`. Reverts DrawNotAwarded unless the      draw is awarded, InvalidTier above the last tier and InvalidPrizeIndex above the tier's      prize count.

returns.skipped: True when the threshold is out of 64-bit range, so no weight can ever pass it and         evaluation stops the tier here.
returns.threshold: The weight a saver must exceed to win this prize.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

walkOf(uint32).details: Both are zero until the first `evaluate` call fixes them from the seed and the saver count.

returns.count: How many savers the walk covers. Named `count` rather than `length`, which         collides with a tuple's own `length` in generated TypeScript clients and makes the         return type unusable there.
returns.start: Index in the saver list the walk begins at.

withdraw(bytes32,bytes).details: An oversized request returns everything instead of reverting, so a balance cannot be probed.      Reverts NotASaver for an address that never deposited. Emits Withdrawn.

withdrawAll().details: Reverts NotASaver for an address that never deposited. Emits Withdrawn.

MAX_BATCH.details: Measured with `fhevm.computeTransactionHCU` against the mock coprocessor's price table,      not on Sepolia, using the Sepolia tier parameters (prize counts 1, 1 and 4      at odds 1/24, 1/6 and 1): 748,032 homomorphic compute units of fixed cost per call plus      3,674,128 per saver. Four savers cost 15,444,544 units at a handle depth of 3,240,000, and      every further saver adds 381,000 to that depth through the tier remainder chain. The      coprocessor caps one transaction at 20,000,000 units and 5,000,000 of depth; Hearth budgets      18,000,000 and 4,500,000 so a heavier tier set still fits. Five savers cost 19,118,672, over      that budget, so the batch stops at four and the next call resumes from the cursor.

_unfunded.details: Winnings credited that the pool failed to back. Always zero when the pool is solvent;      published at every finalization so anyone can check.

SenderNotAllowedToUseHandle(bytes32,addr.notice: Returned if the sender is not allowed to use the handle.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

MAX_BATCH().notice: Savers needing encrypted work per `evaluate` call.

SCALE_PROBES().notice: How many powers of two the aggregate weight is compared against at each close.

SLOTS().notice: Observations kept per saver and for the total. Three slots cover the newest observation at or         before any draw inside its two-period window, because at most two later periods can have         started and so at most two newer observations can have been pushed.

abandonDraw(uint32,uint64[3]).notice: Gives a draw that will never pay back: the plaintext `offered` returns to the pool and the         encrypted part returns to the tier's carry.

carryHandle(uint8).notice: The encrypted liquidity `tier` is carrying into future draws.

confidentialBalanceOf(address).notice: Encrypted principal of `saver`; decryptable by the saver only.

confidentialWinningsOf(address).notice: Encrypted unclaimed winnings of `saver`; decryptable by the saver only.

consumeCarry(uint8,uint64).notice: Subtracts a reconciled `amount` from `tier`'s encrypted carry and clears the publication.

creditHandle(uint32,address).notice: What `saver` won in `drawId`; decryptable by that saver only.

currentPeriod().notice: The period the chain is in right now.

cursorOf(uint32).notice: How far the evaluation walk of `drawId` has advanced.

evaluate(uint32,uint256).notice: Advances the evaluation walk of `drawId` by up to `count` savers, crediting each one what         the published thresholds say they won.

evaluatedCount(uint32).notice: How many savers have been marked done for `drawId`, so the app can show progress.

finalizeDraw(uint32).notice: Folds every tier's unpaid remainder into that tier's carry once the window of `drawId` is         over, and publishes the carry of each tier whose reconcile cadence is due.

finalized(uint32).notice: True once `finalizeDraw` folded `drawId` into the carries, or the draw was abandoned.

firstObservationAt(address).notice: When `saver` first deposited, so evaluation can skip savers who joined after a draw's period.

maxPrincipal().notice: Largest principal a saver may hold, so that balance times period seconds fits 64 bits.

observationOf(address,uint8).notice: One of the saver's three observations: slot 0 is the newest, slot 2 the oldest kept.

onConfidentialTransferReceived(address,a.notice: Deposit entry point, called by the token inside `confidentialTransferAndCall`.

openDraw(uint32,uint64[3]).notice: Moves `offered` plus the tier's encrypted carry into the draw's encrypted liquidity.

opened(uint32).notice: True once the prize pool has moved a draw's liquidity into this vault.

pause().notice: Stops new deposits. Withdrawals, evaluation and finalization are never paused. Draw         closing is stopped by the prize pool's own pause, which is a separate lever.

periodEnd(uint32).notice: The first second of the period after `period`.

periodOf(uint256).notice: The period `timestamp` falls in. Anything before `firstPeriodAt` is period zero.

publishedCarry(uint8).notice: The carry handle `tier` published, the draw it was published at, and whether it is still         waiting to be reconciled.

remainingHandles(uint32).notice: The encrypted liquidity of each tier that `drawId` has not paid out.

renounceOwnership().notice: Disabled: the vault must always have an owner able to pause deposits in an incident.

rescueERC20(address,address).notice: Returns a stray public ERC-20 to `to`. Savers' confidential balances cannot be touched:         the asset is not an ERC-20 and this function cannot move it.

saverAt(uint256).notice: The saver at `index` in the list evaluation walks.

saverCount().notice: How many addresses have ever deposited. The list is never pruned.

scaleFor(uint32,uint8).notice: Compares the aggregate weight of `period` against `2^(scaleBits-2) .. 2^(scaleBits+2)` and         against one, marks both results publicly decryptable and returns them.

scaleHandles(uint32).notice: The scale comparison the vault published for `period`: how many thresholds the aggregate         cleared, and whether anyone held a balance at all.

thresholdOf(uint32,address,uint8,uint32).notice: The public threshold prize `index` of `tier` sets for `saver` in `drawId`.

unfundedHandle().notice: Winnings credited that the prize pool failed to back. Zero whenever the pool is solvent.

walkOf(uint32).notice: Where the evaluation walk of `drawId` starts and how many savers it covers.

weightHandle(uint32,address).notice: The time-weighted balance `saver` was evaluated on for `drawId`; decryptable by that saver         only, so they can check it against the published thresholds themselves.

windowEndsAt(uint32).notice: Last moment at which `drawId` can still be evaluated; finalization opens after it.

withdraw(bytes32,bytes).notice: Withdraws up to `encryptedAmount`, winnings first, then principal, clamped to the saver's         total and to what the vault itself holds.

withdrawAll().notice: Withdraws principal and winnings in full, without an encrypted input.

userdoc.notice: Holds savers' confidential USDC, keeps every balance and time-weighted balance encrypted,         runs the winner test for each saver over those encrypted values, and pays out.
